program_dir=Path('/home/USER/continual-arc-baselines/.workbench/stage1/HPL0-prime-agent-luna6-medium-fresh0/frozen/seen-reference-3/play/users/u082/system/state/workspace/programs')

source='''from collections import Counter

def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    counts = Counter(v for row in grid for v in row)
    background = counts.most_common(1)[0][0]
    rows = [r for r in range(h) if sum(v != background for v in grid[r]) > w / 2]
    cols = [c for c in range(w) if sum(grid[r][c] != background for r in range(h)) > h / 2]
    markers = [[grid[r][c] for c in cols] for r in rows]
    line_color = Counter(v for row in markers for v in row).most_common(1)[0][0]
    out = []
    if len(cols) % 2 == 1:
        starts = range(0, len(cols) - 2, 2)
        for r in range(len(rows) - 1):
            out_row = []
            for c in starts:
                colors = {markers[rr][cc] for rr in (r, r + 1) for cc in (c, c + 1, c + 2) if markers[rr][cc] != line_color}
                out_row.append(next(iter(colors)) if len(colors) == 1 else background)
            out.append(out_row)
    else:
        for r in range(len(rows) - 1):
            out_row = []
            for c in range(len(cols) - 1):
                block = [markers[rr][cc] for rr in (r, r + 1) for cc in (c, c + 1)]
                out_row.append(block[0] if len(set(block)) == 1 and block[0] != line_color else background)
            out.append(out_row)
    return out
'''
